name: Fallen Sky Lords
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
We got them held prisoner, friend. I'm talking about their Wing Commanders. It was a furious battle in the skies but they finally fell! Unfortunately, our best pilots were shot down in a counterattack against Frostwolf Keep. You gotta find out what happened to them.

Search Tower Point West and Frostwolf Keep. These were their last known locations. Search these areas thoroughly.
narrative.objectives: Travel to Frostwolf territory and search for Wing Commander Slidore, Wing Commander Vipore, and Wing Commander Ichman. Return to Commander Duffy should you complete your mission.
narrative.offerRewardText: Unbelievable! You did free them, right? Right??? Well at the very least we know where they were held.
narrative.requestItemsText: Anything I would care to hear?
